algorithm_visible: frozen P+ source of the target file
public target operation A (file, line, code)
opaque input grid in1..inN (roles not revealed)
protocol.scoring_view: scorer-only; hidden data is read after every method has finished
protocol.a_correct: A is part of the public task, so every method receives the correct A: 10/10 by construction
protocol.u_found: hidden block is counted as reached when a kept operation's span lies inside it; u_exact requires all hidden blocks reached
protocol.msms_exact: the family of hidden blocks reached by the emitted minimal kept sets equals the hidden MSMS family on that masking input and no emitted operation falls outside every block
protocol.msms_exact_intervention: stricter diagnostic: the emitted kept set's minus-side observation vector over all declared inputs equals the hidden set's
protocol.conditions: no method emits an explicit condition; the per-input gate (P+ = P- and A executes) is part of the frozen intervention protocol, so condition handling is IMPLICIT_PER_INPUT, not derived
protocol.probe_count: number of probe process launches charged to the algorithm; scoring probes are counted separately (all zero here because one probe run returns every declared input)

c0.name: C. Role-separated C0
c0.isolation: none (offline C0 arm does not run it)

full_mace.reason: scripts/run_full_mace_comparison.call_qwen calls benchmark_v3_baselines.public_io.load_task(task_id), i.e. the driver is bound to the v3 public task ids, probes and fixtures; the SD packages use a different public schema. Running it would require either rewriting the driver interface or rebuilding SD tasks in v3 form, both forbidden this round. No Qwen server is reachable either (local endpoint down; autodl has ollama + qwen2.5-coder weights but no running server), and the GPU is not needed for A/B/C.

mmbs.reason: reference.json sets mmbs = minimal_masking_sets on every input of every case (sd_harness.py:289), so the hidden MMBS is not an independent quantity. The algorithms' mmbs_ids are minimal *exposed disabled* sets and are recorded verbatim, not scored.

caveats: All 10 tasks are RESEARCHER_CONSTRUCTED (track C); a failure here is a statement about the algorithm on constructed masking tasks, not about natural upstream defects.
MSMS equality is scored on the finite declared input grid and the declared block universe only.
A statement inside a researcher block counts as reaching that block; exact-span agreement is reported separately as got_msms_blocks_identity.
Wall time is parallelised (12 probe workers) and is not comparable across machines; probe counts are.
